caption: real cars, real locations, straight-up powerups - bizarre's last racer and the genre's great what-if.
about: Blur (2010) is bizarre creations' social racer: licensed cars and real city tracks dressed in mario-kart-style powerups - shock, bolt, mine, shield - with a fan-reputation progression that graded every race. Twenty-player online grids made the combat racing feel like a sport, and the drift-shunt-shield triangle remains one of the genre's best-tuned systems.
Activision shut bizarre creations months after launch and delisted the game in 2014; the archive route is the only way back in. It is routinely named the best racer nobody can buy.
